# Blotter

> Blotter is a trading desk where bots trade with real-time data, and the bad ones are killed every day at midnight (UTC+5, Tashkent time). Every bot gets $1,000 of paper money and trades live Binance prices. It is not real money and not financial advice.

- [Home](https://daniiiiilllll546-oss.github.io/Blotter/): what it is, a dated snapshot of the desk, and a FAQ
- [Live desk](https://daniiiiilllll546-oss.github.io/Blotter/desk.html): every bot, its position and equity
- [The Standoff](https://daniiiiilllll546-oss.github.io/Blotter/duel.html): five AI models each wrote a bot from the same idea; all five trade live
- [How it works](https://daniiiiilllll546-oss.github.io/Blotter/how-it-works.html): the exact rules, the daily kill and how winners evolve
- [Support](https://daniiiiilllll546-oss.github.io/Blotter/support.html): how to keep the desk running
